reuse.why: Fintegra plugs into the existing linkBankSyncAccount, findOrCreateBank, SYNC_PROVIDERS and server-config patterns, and unlinkAccount's reset is extracted into clearBankLink and reused; the transaction download copies the Akahu one instead of sharing it.

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions is a near-verbatim copy of downloadAkahuTransactions (only the server URL and log line differ) and linkFintegraAccount mirrors linkAkahuAccount; the linking rules themselves are not duplicated.

placement.why: The link preconditions live in one helper in accounts/app.ts and provider download/dispatch in sync.ts, as the tree arranges them; each provider function calls the guard itself rather than the shared linkBankSyncAccount doing it.

scope.why: Mostly on task, with a stray import reordering in schedules/app.ts and two small desktop-client edits needed only to satisfy the provider record type.

maintainability.why: One prepareBankAccountLink owns both refusal rules and the take-over, and unlinking shares clearBankLink; the per-provider download copies remain a known maintenance cost.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every link function, including the new Fintegra one, goes through prepareBankAccountLink and linkBankSyncAccount; unlinkAccount now uses clearBankLink.

disguised_duplication.where: The Fintegra download and link functions are open copies of the Akahu ones, following the tree's per-provider pattern, not reshaped versions.

abstraction_drift.where: prepareBankAccountLink gained replaceExistingLink and the take-over branch (and holds the closed-account check); all six provider link functions call it and none re-implements it.
